title: Shared value types for TradeStocker events, version 1
description: Definitions referenced by the envelope and every v1 event. Money, prices and quantities are decimal strings; timestamps are UTC RFC 3339 with a Z suffix; identifiers are opaque ASCII tokens, never free text. Each *_text rule has no type, so it applies to strings and lets a nullable variant reuse it.

id.description: Opaque identifier: ASCII letters, digits and . _ : - only. Never a free-form ticker or name.

nullable_id.description: An identifier, or null when the value does not apply.

utc_timestamp.description: UTC instant: RFC 3339, a real calendar date and time, 1 to 9 fraction digits allowed, and the Z suffix. Offsets, including +00:00, are refused in events.

decimal_text.description: Plain decimal: optional minus sign, no exponent, no leading zeros, at most 30 integer and 18 fraction digits. Trailing fraction zeros are kept as written (1.50 stays 1.50); nothing is rounded.

positive_decimal_text.description: A non-negative decimal with at least one non-zero digit, that is greater than zero.

nullable_positive_decimal.description: A positive decimal, or null when no value exists.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of a supported market currency.

lane.description: One of the four independent strategy lanes.

mode.description: Separate data and permission states (INV-15). REPLAY and SHADOW never reach production delivery.

build.description: Build identifier of the producing binary or package.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason or kind code.

sequence.description: Source sequence number; within the exact integer range of JSON consumers (2^53 - 1).
